texts.zh:
星海共同体的官员收到了我们最近就缇扬奇族母取得胜利的消息。他们告诉我方，消灭这只野兽明显违反了缇扬奇保护法，就算缇扬奇族母是敌对生物也一样。

[Root.GetName]将在接下来十年内被视为违反星系法。此外，我们收到了一份巨额的罚单，理由是我们消灭了“一种独特的，整个星系中再也见不到的缇扬奇生命形式”。
texts.en:
Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile nature.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. Additionally, we have been issued with a hefty fine for our killing of "a unique Tiyanki life form whose like the galaxy shall never see again."

label.en: It had to be put down.

label.zh: 但是……是它攻击我们的啊！
